seo.title: Grey Spaces — Architecture & Interiors
seo.description: Grey Spaces is an architecture and interior design studio creating calm, light-filled spaces that are built to last.

chapters.label: Light
chapters.title: Light is the first material.
chapters.quote: Bare concrete, a single cut, and the sun does the rest.
chapters.body: We begin every project by studying how daylight enters, moves and leaves. Openings are placed with intent, so a room changes character from morning to dusk.

chapters.label: Less
chapters.title: Less, but better.
chapters.body: A floating roof, a free plan and honest materials. We remove everything that does not serve the space, until what remains feels calm and complete.

chapters.label: Nature
chapters.title: Built with the land, not on it.
chapters.quote: Study nature, love nature, stay close to nature.
chapters.body: Terraces reach over water, stone rises from the ground. We let the site lead — its slope, its trees, its views — so the building belongs where it stands.

chapters.label: Flow
chapters.title: Space in motion.
chapters.quote: There are 360 degrees, so why stick to one?
chapters.body: Where a project calls for it, we let form move freely. Continuous surfaces guide people through space the way water finds its course.

finale.quote: Architecture is the thoughtful making of space.
finale.author: Louis Kahn

studio.title: Recreating dream spaces that last.
studio.body: Grey Spaces is a design studio for architecture and interiors. From the first sketch to the final finish, one team carries your project with care — balancing beauty, budget and the way you actually live.

services.title: What we do
services.intro: Full-service design, from the shell of the building to the last detail inside.

items.title: Architecture
items.body: New homes and buildings, from concept to construction drawings.

items.title: Interior design
items.body: Complete interiors — layouts, materials, lighting and furniture.

items.title: Renovation
items.body: Thoughtful remodelling of kitchens, bathrooms and whole homes.

items.title: Landscape
items.body: Gardens, courtyards and terraces that extend the living space.

projects.title: Portfolio
projects.intro: A few of the spaces we have shaped.

steps.title: Listen
steps.body: We start with how you live, what you love and what the site offers.

steps.title: Imagine
steps.body: Concepts, moodboards and 3D views until the direction feels right.

steps.title: Refine
steps.body: Materials, details and drawings, resolved with you step by step.

steps.title: Build

contact.title: Let’s bring your vision to life
